cv.page_description: Tailor your resume to a specific job — pick one from your list or paste any job post. Review every change before saving.
cv.step_select_cv_hint: Choose the resume you want to optimize
cv.step_select_job_hint: Pick the job you are applying for
cv.analysis_cached_hint: Cached result. Click Re-analyze to regenerate with the LLM.
cv.no_llm_description: You need to configure an LLM provider in Settings to use AI-powered features.
cv.no_cvs_hint: Upload a resume first from the Resumes page.
cv.no_jobs_hint: Scrape some jobs first from the Jobs page.

cover_letter.page_description: Generate a personalized cover letter for a specific job application.
cover_letter.no_previous: No previous cover letters for this combination.
cover_letter.no_llm_description: You need to configure an LLM provider in Settings to use AI-powered features.
cover_letter.paste_job_hint: Not in your list? Paste the job post from any website.

progress.phase_analyzing: Analyzing the match with the job

chat.title: Refine with AI
chat.description: Ask the assistant to make changes — e.g. "shorten the summary", "add a bullet about X to my role at Y", "emphasize my AWS experience".
chat.empty_state: Ask for any change to your optimized CV. The model will rewrite it preserving your real data.
chat.finish_editing_first: Finish or cancel your edit before sending a message.
chat.tmpl_remove_figures: Remove these figures — they are not in my original CV: {{list}}. Describe the impact in words instead.
chat.tmpl_remove_skill: Remove every mention of "{{skill}}" from the CV.
chat.tmpl_remove_tech: Remove these technologies — I haven't used them: {{list}}.

quick.shorter_msg: Make the CV more concise: tighten the summary and bullets without losing keywords.
quick.stronger_msg: Use stronger action verbs and outcome-focused wording in the experience bullets.
quick.keywords_msg: Weave in more of the job post's keywords where they fit my existing experience.

setup.job_hint: Pick a job from your list, or paste any job post from the internet
setup.switch_confirm_description: You have unsaved changes to an optimized CV for another CV or job. Switching will discard them. Save it first if you want to keep it.

analysis.stale: Your CV or the job changed since this analysis. Re-analyze for accurate results.
analysis.auto_hint: The match analysis runs automatically when you generate.

skills_to_add.title: Skills from the job post to add ({{count}})
skills_to_add.hint: These will be added to your Skills, Summary and related bullets. Uncheck any you couldn't discuss in an interview.

errors.auth: The AI provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
errors.rate_limit: The AI provider is rate-limiting requests or your quota is exhausted. Wait a moment and retry.
errors.context_length: The CV and job post are too long for this model. Try a model with a larger context window.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the AI provider. Check your internet connection, or for Ollama, that the server is running and reachable.
errors.model_not_found: The selected model isn't available. Pick another model in Settings (for Ollama, install it first with ollama pull).
errors.empty_output: The model returned no CV text. Try again or pick another model.
errors.empty_output_reasoning: The model spent its whole budget thinking and wrote no CV text. Retry, or choose a non-reasoning model in Settings.
errors.placeholder: The model started writing placeholder content, so the output was discarded to protect your CV. Try again.
errors.runaway: The model's output kept growing without ending, so it was stopped. Try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while talking to the AI provider.

review.edit_shortcuts: Ctrl+Enter to save · Esc to cancel
review.ai_removed_section: The AI left this section out. Keep original to bring it back.
review.flag_new_claim_hint: Skill from the job post that isn't in your original CV. Be ready to discuss it in an interview.
review.flag_unsupported_hint: This figure doesn't appear in your original CV. Remove it unless it's accurate.
review.flag_new_tech_hint: This technology is neither in your CV nor in the job post.
review.markdown_hint: Edit the whole CV as markdown — useful for renaming headings or big restructures. Changes appear as your edits in the review.
review.banner_truncated: The model hit its output limit, so the end of the CV may be missing. Sections it didn't reach keep your original text — review the last sections or regenerate.
review.banner_translated: Your CV is being translated to the job post's language, so every section shows as changed. Keeping a section original leaves it in the original language.

score.tooltip: Share of the job post's keywords (weighted by importance) found in the CV. Deterministic ATS-style check, updated live as you edit.
score.measure_real_match: Run a full AI match analysis on the saved CV

claims.title: Check before sending
claims.description: Claims that go beyond your original CV.
claims.empty: Nothing to check — every claim is backed by your original CV.
claims.skills_title: Skills added from the job post ({{count}})
claims.skills_hint: Recruiters may ask about these. Remove any you can't talk about.
claims.tech_hint: Not in your CV and not in the job post — likely invented.

save.dialog_description: It will appear in your CV list. You can also export a copy to your computer.
save.export_label: Also save a file to my computer
save.export_hint: You'll choose the folder in the next step. PDF is best for sending; Word for editing.
save.as_new: Save as a new CV instead of updating
save.saved: Optimized CV saved to your CVs
save.export_cancelled_kept: File export cancelled — the CV is still saved in your CVs.

save_check.title: A few things to check first
save_check.description: Recruiters may ask about anything on your CV.
save_check.figures: {{count}} figure(s) not found in your original CV:
save_check.claims: {{count}} skill(s) from the job post you haven't confirmed:
save_check.truncated: The model's output was cut off — the last sections may be incomplete.

regenerate_confirm.title: Regenerate the optimized CV?
regenerate_confirm.description: Your manual edits and kept-original choices will be replaced by a new AI proposal. You can undo this with Ctrl+Z.

session.interrupted: The last generation was interrupted (the app was closed). Your previous review, if any, is shown — generate again to continue.
